title: Latent Sky data manifest
description: THE contract between pipeline/ (producer) and web/ (consumer). The web app renders only what this file declares; the pipeline emits this file last, after every referenced asset exists and every identity checksum has been verified.

init.description: Forecast initialisation time. Absent for dev-sample, whose frames are independent analysis times.

generatedNote.description: The scientific-honesty caption shown in the UI. Required — a build without it fails.

frames.description: Valid times, one per frame index, strictly increasing. Layer frame arrays index into this.

basemap.description: Optional offline-baked basemap imagery. Paths relative to the manifest. Licence must be public-domain or CC-BY (audited in licences/MANIFEST.yaml) — basemaps ship.

globalRect.description: west, south, east, north in degrees; defaults to [-180,-90,180,90]

hero.description: Crisp regional basemap over the hero rectangle

lut.description: Path to the 256x1 RGBA LUT PNG shared by every layer of this variable

identity.description: sha256 of the canonical (variable, lut sha256, vmin, vmax, alphaPolicy) tuple. The build FAILS if two layers of the same variable disagree. The web app asserts coarse/fine equality again at load.

frames.description: Relative WebP path per frame, same length and order as top-level frames

pairWith.description: For hero layers: the layer id this one is compared against in the reveal
